# Local Three.js distribution

This directory contains a local copy of Three.js used by the
Industrial Digital Twin Platform.

Version: 0.185.1

Included files:

- build/three.module.js
- build/three.core.js
- addons/controls/OrbitControls.js
- addons/loaders/STLLoader.js
- LICENSE

Runtime internet access is not required.

The files were copied from the official npm package:

three@0.185.1

Do not edit the vendor source files directly.
Application-specific viewer code is located in:

core/static/core/js/stl-viewer.js
